init_sem_exp_agent: create a Sem_Exp_Env_Agent instance with a config to initialize semantic prediction and planning
reset_agent_episode: reset the Sem_Exp_Env_Agent for a new episode with a goal name and observation size
plan_act_and_preprocess: run the agent planning loop to compute actions from map predictions and pose data
get_short_term_goal: get a short-term goal using FMM planner with obstacle dilation and collision avoidance
preprocess_observations: preprocess RGB-D observations with semantic segmentation prediction for the agent state
